detector._note: Keypoints 23-25-27 / 24-26-28 (hip-knee-ankle), 3D world angle, both knees. Standing is 150-160 on this app rather than the 180 geometry promises, for the same edge-on reason the arms read low. A correct squat turns at 65-72.

stage._note: fitmon countSquats, retuned to the player's range 6 Sep 2026: HIP-KNEE-ANKLE, both knees. The bottom of a squat is 65-72 and the top is 150-160, so the counter arms below 72 and the rep lands crossing 150 on the way up. The reference animation agrees: it reaches 65.5 at the deepest and 168.6 standing, both measured off traces/reference-squat.jsonl. Ceiling 175 is above any real stand, so it only refuses a frame reporting a knee straighter than a knee goes. Counting stays at the CROSSING: a squat is at rest at the bottom, so judging the whole cycle would land each rep at the start of the next.

tempo._note: measured window: topExit crossing -> bottomEnter crossing, not the full descent

cues.tooHigh: Sit deeper — knees to 100° or less.
cues.framing: I can't see your knees — step back.
